t: This is Albany, an apartment complex on Piccadilly. The three-storey mansion was built in the 1770s and divided into apartments in 1802. It was commissioned by Peniston Lamb, Viscount Melbourne, and designed by William Chambers, the architect of Somerset House, with Henry Holland also credited as designer. His wife Elizabeth, Lady Melbourne, a leading political hostess of the Regency, died here. Their son William became Prime Minister. Two others died here as well: the broadcaster and academic Anthony Smith, and the railway economist Sir William Mitchell Acworth.
